title: Creamy Tuscan {p} Pasta
steps: Cook the {s} in salted water following the package directions. Drain, saving a splash of the cooking water.
Crumble the {p} into a large skillet and brown over medium-high heat 5 to 6 minutes, until {doneness}. Move to a plate.
Cook the {v} in the same pan for 3 to 4 minutes, until softened, then stir in the {spice} for a minute.
Pour in the {sauce} and simmer 6 to 8 minutes, until lightly thickened.
Return the {p} and the {s} to the pan, toss 1 to 2 minutes so the sauce clings, and finish with grated Parmesan.
tip: Use half the cream with a splash of the pasta water, and double the spinach.
